name: Suspicious Harbor Fish Burger
desc: A fish burger. It features a fillet of a dull, greyish hue that fills one with hesitation. A bitter surge assaults your senses from the very first bite, just like a cup of frigid seawater utterly douses any lingering sparks of hope. It seems excessive marinating has stripped the fish of the freshness it once possessed...

customize.name: Recipe: Harbor Fish Burger
customize.desc: A detailed step-by-step recipe for making Harbor Fish Burger.

customize.name: Harbor Fish Burger
customize.desc: A fish burger. Freshly baked bread is sliced open. Then, layers of crisp greens, seasoned fish fillet, and sliced onions are added to it. Finally, it is finished with a drizzle of sauce. The burger has a savory-tart flavor that truly whets the appetite.

customize.name: Delicious Harbor Fish Burger
customize.desc: A fish burger. The hearty bread, tender fish, and crunchy toppings create a collision of textures that compels one to devour it in great, eager bites. Local rumors claim some families have uprooted their entire lives to Dornman Port just for a daily taste of this authentic delicacy. It seems those tales were no exaggeration...
